component: Component 3 - Smart Layer-Wise Rubber Smokehouse Drying-Time & Fire-Risk Prediction System

promotion_history.superseded_reason: Ordinal XGBoost Classifier with Argmax Decision Rule passed the promotion-readiness gate with higher Critical Recall, Critical F2, Macro F1, and Balanced Accuracy on development-only GroupKFold evidence, while remaining above the 0.80 Warning Recall guardrail.

historical_locked_stage31_test.note: This Stage-31 evaluation belongs to XGB_03 only. It is preserved unmodified and must never be presented as an evaluation of the Ordinal classifier.

training_scope.note: Component3_Test.csv (4,058 rows, 2 batches) was never loaded for fitting, threshold selection, or promotion decision-making for the Ordinal classifier. Existence-checked (SHA256) only.

feature_contract.note: Identical Stage-07/Stage-08 feature contract as XGB_03. No feature engineering or feature selection was modified for the Ordinal classifier.

regression.note: Not touched, retrained, retuned, or re-evaluated during classification finalization.

classification.model_name: Ordinal XGBoost Classifier with Argmax Decision Rule

architecture.type: Two cumulative binary XGBoost estimators + deterministic probability reconstruction
architecture.shared_preprocessing: Median imputation + StandardScaler (numeric), OneHotEncoder handle_unknown='ignore' (categorical) - identical recipe to Stage-10/Stage-30, fitted on Development only

O1.class_weighting: compute_sample_weight('balanced'), computed from Development O1 target distribution

O2.class_weighting: compute_sample_weight('balanced'), computed from Development O2 target distribution

architecture.decision_rule: argmax(P_Normal, P_Warning, P_Critical) - no hidden thresholding

development_groupkfold_evidence.methodology: 5-fold GroupKFold by Batch_ID, Development = Train + Validation only, fold-local preprocessing and fold-local balanced weights, Test never loaded

classification.critical_detection_limitation: Critical-class generalization remains limited and batch-sensitive. 2 of 6 Critical-containing development batches produced zero Critical Recall under every method tested across two full rounds of controlled experimentation. This is a structural data-scarcity limitation (only 6 of 10 development batches contain any Critical example), not solely a modeling deficiency. All Critical-risk performance claims must preserve this limitation.
classification.stage31_policy: The historical Stage-31 locked test evaluated XGB_03 only and has NOT been rerun for the Ordinal classifier, because the Test set has already been observed historically during the XGB_03 research process and cannot be presented as an untouched independent test for a newly promoted model. See promotion_history above for the preserved XGB_03 Stage-31 result.

research_integrity.deployment_scope: Research/prototype decision support pending independent field/expert validation. NOT a certified fire alarm, guaranteed fire detector, or production safety device.

explainability.method: SHAP (TreeExplainer), computed separately for O1 and O2
explainability.note: SHAP explains model behavior/association only, not physical causation. Historical Stage-32 XGB_03 SHAP evidence (outputs/reports/32_*) was not modified.
